import {openTraceFile} from 'agent-inspect/readers';
import {evaluateTraceContract} from 'agent-inspect/checks';
import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
const paths={source:new URL('../otlp-evidence/O05-repeated-delivery.source.jsonl',import.meta.url).pathname,otlp:new URL('../otlp-evidence/O05-repeated-delivery.default-otlp.json',import.meta.url).pathname};
const results=[];
for(const [format,file] of Object.entries(paths)){
  const read=await openTraceFile(file);
  for(const maxAttempts of [1,2]){
    const result=evaluateTraceContract({read},{retry:{maxAttempts}});
    results.push({format,maxAttempts,status:result.status,findings:result.findings.map(f=>({ruleId:f.ruleId,actual:f.actual,message:f.message}))});
  }
}
writeFileSync(new URL('../otlp-delivery-boundary-results.json',import.meta.url),JSON.stringify(results,null,2)+'\n');
console.log(JSON.stringify(results,null,2));
const source=results.find(r=>r.format==='source'&&r.maxAttempts===2);
const exported=results.find(r=>r.format==='otlp'&&r.maxAttempts===2);
if(source.status!==exported.status)process.exitCode=1;
